title: Fly over the Eden Project on the SkyWire
description: Launch headfirst on a 660-metre zipline above the Eden Project’s giant biomes, reaching speeds of up to 60 mph with a wide view across the former clay pit.

title: Visit ICEHOTEL’s ice art exhibition by day
description: Enter ICEHOTEL’s frozen art exhibition on a guided Jukkasjärvi visit, with the village’s historic church and a Sámi reindeer stop completing the three-hour outing.

title: Canyon through the Orlias waterfalls on Mount Olympus
description: Follow Orlias stream through a forested gorge at the foot of Mount Olympus, descending its pools and waterfalls with guided rappels, slides and jumps adjusted for beginners.

title: Kayak and snorkel beneath Cabo de Gata’s volcanic cliffs
description: Paddle below Cabo de Gata’s volcanic cliffs into clear-water coves, then snorkel to see the protected coast’s marine life at water level.

title: Cross the Bardenas Reales badlands by guided 4x4
description: Travel the authorised dirt tracks of the Bardenas Reales with a local guide, stopping among eroded ridges, desert viewpoints and landmark formations such as Castildetierra.

title: Climb the forest rope courses above Wörthersee
description: Move between platforms high in the Pyramidenkogel forest on five graded rope courses, finishing sections on flying-fox lines with views toward Wörthersee.
